governing_claim: Watson Hartsoe researches how language, media, and computation become worlds.

nodes.title: Operation Describe
nodes.thesis: Central research engine: ekphrasis, thick description, and generative AI converge into worldtext theory.
nodes.bridge: Description no longer stands outside the world; it becomes a generative operation inside it.

nodes.title: METISIM
nodes.thesis: Myth as adaptive computation rather than static content.
nodes.bridge: If Operation Describe asks how description becomes world, METISIM asks how myth becomes system behavior.

nodes.title: Mythos Canon
nodes.thesis: 78 documents: chapters, viewers, manifestos, film systems, and defense materials as navigable research surface.
nodes.bridge: The archive becomes a worldtext when its viewers and chapters become navigable parts of the argument.

nodes.title: Myth as OS
nodes.thesis: Language is the root process that scripts reality; media are the engines that run it. Myth as operating system for cultural computation.
nodes.bridge: If METISIM simulates myth, Myth-as-OS declares myth IS the operating system.

nodes.title: Arkadu
nodes.thesis: Noah's Ark meets Nelson's Xanadu: a hyperlinked archive cosmology for AI filmmaking and generative production pipelines.
nodes.bridge: Archive becomes cosmology when every artifact links to every other artifact in a navigable structure.

nodes.title: Ecology of Media
nodes.thesis: Operative ekphrasis as public video practice: theory composed with AI across image, voice, and episode.
nodes.bridge: Worldtext as media ecology: prompts, tools, voices, images form an inhabitable series.

nodes.title: The Medium as Operator
nodes.thesis: Carey vs Kittler, operative ekphrasis, AI text-image systems, prompt rewriting.
nodes.bridge: Worldtext is teachable as a media practice.

nodes.title: ABC-FLIX / ICARO
nodes.thesis: BEFLIX-128 lineage: a unified production bus that harnesses cross-iframe instruments (engine + tunnel) through a hardened message router, turning prompt-driven media into inspectable temporal sequences.
nodes.bridge: The harness proves that worldtext is not a single artifact but a production architecture: engine, tunnel, bus, cursor, sync, and frame patch become the operative grammar of AI filmmaking.

nodes.title: MOTO
nodes.thesis: The highest-density instrument in the constellation (1541 touches). Sound, broadcast, and media deck infrastructure.
nodes.bridge: If worldtext operates through images and code, MOTO proves it also operates through sound, broadcast, and rhythmic structure.

nodes.title: Sense Ritual
nodes.thesis: Digital architectures that condition cognition through ritual repetition: prompts become playable instruments rather than disposable inputs.
nodes.bridge: Ritual transforms prompt from instruction into inhabited practice.

nodes.title: Pretext Field
nodes.thesis: Spatial scholarship instrument: mapping how urban environments are manufactured, stratified, and perceived through operative description.
nodes.bridge: The city becomes a worldtext when its spatial logic is made inspectable through cartographic instruments.

nodes.title: Blue Deli / Blue Belt Films
nodes.thesis: Collaborative AI filmmaking infrastructure: matrix editor, world prompt, emergent narrative as operative media production.
nodes.bridge: Film becomes worldtext when its production pipeline is prompt-driven, inspectable, and revisable.

nodes.title: TRACTOR / WAG
nodes.thesis: Words Assemble Geometry: language as executable spatial specification routed through planning, compilation, inspectable world files, and browser rendering.
nodes.bridge: WAG is the strongest practice-based evidence that description becomes construction.

nodes.title: Ripples
nodes.thesis: Relational Imagination of Perspective, Presence, and Latent Ecologies in Space. Accepted at ELO 2026 with Marttila and Bolter.
nodes.bridge: Ripples proves worldtext enters the body: browser motion becomes a medium for distant writing and ecological orchestration.

nodes.title: LEGOS
nodes.thesis: Location, Entity, Goal, Obstacle, Shift, Solution — a structural grammar for narrative that becomes executable inside generative pipelines.
nodes.bridge: LEGOS proves worldtext has grammar: narrative components become compilable, not just describable.

nodes.title: Ethics Infrastructure
nodes.thesis: Prompts as executable specs. If prompts operate media systems, ethical constraints must be built into workflow and interface states.
nodes.bridge: Ethics Infrastructure gives worldtext its accountability edge: the build system enforces what the theory claims.

nodes.title: Twine Bridge / Island Ecology
nodes.thesis: Do not administer unstructured narrative data if preservation of original poetic structure matters. A bridge between Twine-based interactive fiction and structured ecological narrative.
nodes.bridge: Twine Bridge shows worldtext entering humanities: narrative ecology becomes an inspectable, playable, preservable system.

nodes.title: Fourth Shield
nodes.thesis: A neurosymbolic simulation journey from ancient poetry to executable code: exploring the Shield of Achilles as the original worldtext.
nodes.bridge: Fourth Shield is the origin myth of the dissertation: ekphrastic description becoming operational inside a generative pipeline.

nodes.title: Tractor Field Notes
nodes.thesis: Field notes for a geometric folk logic of circles, trade, and flux. The observational companion to TRACTOR's formal compilation.
nodes.bridge: If TRACTOR compiles worlds, Field Notes documents the folk reasoning that feeds the compiler.

nodes.title: Growing Entanglements
nodes.thesis: Cultural theory as digital interfaces: Sahlins, Obeyesekere, Captain Cook, resistance topology.
nodes.bridge: Cultural interpretation becomes a navigable apparatus.

nodes.title: Rosetta Protocol
nodes.thesis: Terminal-like viewer turning scattered HTML artifacts into browsable research surface.
nodes.bridge: The archive does not merely store worldtexts; it becomes a worldtext interface itself.

nodes.title: Hyperclay / Uncontracting
nodes.thesis: Interface as philosophical apparatus: boundaries, meanings, agreements dissolve through interaction.
nodes.bridge: Interface behavior as meaning-making world rather than neutral container.

nodes.title: Legacy Portfolio
nodes.thesis: Earlier public identity: virtual environments, participatory design, museums, youth programs.
nodes.bridge: Retained as lineage, not current front door.

nodes.title: Hubs Cloud
nodes.thesis: Museum collections and histories becoming inhabitable social VR spaces.
nodes.bridge: Museum collection becomes virtual place; intern becomes world-author.

nodes.title: Future Oceans
nodes.thesis: Environmental futures as web VR worlds through tangible making and ocean robotics.
nodes.bridge: Ocean problem becomes immersive scenario; tangible prototype becomes virtual environment.

nodes.title: Life Cycle
nodes.thesis: Myth, migration, cardboard, Scratch, and Makey Makey as computational storytelling.
nodes.bridge: Mythic creature becomes computational avatar; cardboard becomes interface.

nodes.title: Pinball Sandbox
nodes.thesis: Games, circuits, and recycled materials as tangible computing.
nodes.bridge: Industrial excess becomes playable computation.

nodes.title: Future Scouts
nodes.thesis: Youth development as civic futures prototyping through speculative design.
nodes.bridge: Future language becomes artifact; youth become authors of possible worlds.

nodes.title: Leimert Phone Company
nodes.thesis: Afrofuturist civic imagination through autonomous cars, AR, and community worldbuilding.
nodes.bridge: Community narrative becomes speculative infrastructure.

nodes.title: Ojo Joven
nodes.thesis: Youth photography as community narrative infrastructure in Honduras.
nodes.bridge: Photograph becomes spark; spark becomes conversation; conversation becomes community narrative.

nodes.title: Artes Sin Fronteras
nodes.thesis: Participant observation and arts-based research in Central America.
nodes.bridge: Fieldwork becomes a practice of witnessing how communities use media to contest violence.

nodes.title: Hogares Sostenibles
nodes.thesis: Household sanitation as ecological interface in Guatemala.
nodes.bridge: A toilet becomes an interface; rainfall becomes resource; household routine becomes ecological design.

nodes.title: Medium Essays
nodes.thesis: Public-facing argument stream on AI culture, media theory, and worldtext-adjacent claims.
nodes.bridge: Theory entering public conflict.

nodes.title: Nushi
nodes.thesis: Virtual character becomes robotic media creature: mascot, influencer, camera, livestream source.
nodes.bridge: Fictional character becomes robot; robot becomes media channel; media channel becomes social world.

nodes.title: Say What You See
nodes.thesis: Collaborative drawing as interface for workplace conflict and shared visual starting points.
nodes.bridge: Drawing becomes social interface; interface becomes conversation.
